description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Bingiriya, Kurunegala, Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
